formulas.water_balance: storage_t = clip(storage_(t-1) + effective_rainfall + irrigation - actual_ET - drainage, 0, TAW)
formulas.actual_ET: actual_ET = potential_ETc * Ks; Ks is a simplified provisional storage-based stress factor

provisional_parameters.status: Prototype assumptions; require literature support, soil data, or field calibration.

validation.weather_quality: Required weather inputs checked for missing values and duplicate dates during generation.
validation.water_balance_arithmetic: Storage equation uses effective rainfall, which already excludes runoff; runoff is not subtracted a second time.

limitations: NASA POWER is gridded weather data, not on-farm sensor measurements.
ET0 implementation approximates actual vapour pressure from daily mean relative humidity.
Kc, root-zone depth, FC, WP, runoff, drainage, initial storage and stress threshold are provisional.
The weather_only scenario applies zero irrigation.
Modelled moisture and stress labels are not ground truth.
Stress labels are generated by the same model being evaluated.
No agronomic accuracy claim is justified without independent field validation.
TNAU source summaries must be verified against current official pages before operational use.
